review: 702.2c-1: the two_blockers variant blocked with a Grizzly Bears that was not on B's battlefield, so it changed the setup and the blocks at once; put Grizzly Bears on B's battlefield in the base setup (not blocking) so the variant changes only the block declaration.

skipped.reason: cannot be illustrated with cards Forge implements: it needs a deathtouch source that deals damage from the hand, graveyard, exile or library (a card in such a zone made to deal damage while holding deathtouch), and no simple, well-known card reaches that state in a two-player game; the deathtouch outcome itself is covered by 702.2b-1, 702.2b-2 and 702.2e-1

scenarios.title: A creature dealt combat damage by a deathtouch source is destroyed regardless of toughness
decisions: A attacks player B with Hill Giant.
B blocks Hill Giant with Typhoid Rats.
No spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: deathtouch_blocker
variants.expected: Hill Giant deals 3 damage to Typhoid Rats and Typhoid Rats deals 1 damage to Hill Giant. Both creatures are destroyed and are in their owners' graveyards. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: plain_blocker
variants.delta: B's blocker is Mons's Goblin Raiders (1/1, no abilities) instead of Typhoid Rats.
variants.expected: Hill Giant deals 3 damage to Mons's Goblin Raiders, which is destroyed. Hill Giant has 1 damage marked and stays on the battlefield. B's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: Noncombat damage from a deathtouch source destroys a creature

setup.notes: Basilisk Collar is already attached, so no equip cost is paid.

decisions: A activates Prodigal Sorcerer, tapping it as the cost, targeting Hill Giant.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.
Both players pass with the stack empty.

variants.label: equipped
variants.expected: Prodigal Sorcerer deals 1 damage to Hill Giant, which is destroyed in the next state-based check and is in B's graveyard. A gains 1 life (20 to 21) from lifelink.

variants.label: unequipped
variants.delta: Basilisk Collar is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Prodigal Sorcerer deals 1 damage to Hill Giant, which stays on the battlefield with 1 damage marked. A's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: With deathtouch and trample, 1 damage is lethal to each blocker and the rest tramples over

setup.notes: Basilisk Collar gives the trampling Colossal Dreadmaw deathtouch and lifelink. B's Grizzly Bears does not block in the base variant.

decisions: A attacks player B with Colossal Dreadmaw.
B blocks Colossal Dreadmaw with Hill Giant only; Grizzly Bears does not block.
A assigns 1 damage to Hill Giant and 5 damage to player B.
No spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: deathtouch_trample
variants.expected: Hill Giant takes 1 damage from a deathtouch source and is destroyed. B takes 5 damage (life 15). Hill Giant deals 3 damage to Colossal Dreadmaw, which survives. A gains 6 life from lifelink (life 26).

variants.label: no_collar
variants.delta: Basilisk Collar is not on the battlefield, so A must assign 3 damage (lethal) to Hill Giant and assigns the other 3 damage to player B.
variants.expected: Hill Giant is destroyed by 3 damage. B takes 3 damage (life 17). A's life stays 20. Colossal Dreadmaw survives with 3 damage marked.

variants.label: two_blockers
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears also blocks Colossal Dreadmaw, and A assigns 1 damage to Hill Giant, 1 damage to Grizzly Bears and 4 damage to player B.
variants.expected: Hill Giant and Grizzly Bears are both destroyed. B takes 4 damage (life 16). Colossal Dreadmaw takes 5 damage and survives. A gains 6 life (life 26).

scenarios.forge_notes: Lifelink and the two-blocker variant add observable side effects; the damage assignment must be fixed by the harness rather than by Forge's AI.

scenarios.title: A source that left the battlefield is judged by its last known information for deathtouch
decisions: A activates Mogg Fanatic, sacrificing it as the cost, targeting Hill Giant.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.
Both players pass with the stack empty.

variants.label: equipped_when_sacrificed
variants.expected: Mogg Fanatic is in A's graveyard and Basilisk Collar is unattached on A's battlefield. The ability deals 1 damage to Hill Giant, which is destroyed in the next state-based check. A gains 1 life (life 21).

variants.label: unequipped
variants.delta: Basilisk Collar is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Mogg Fanatic is in A's graveyard. The ability deals 1 damage to Hill Giant, which stays on the battlefield with 1 damage marked. A's life stays 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Depends on Forge capturing the sacrificed creature's keywords (last known information) as the damage source; if it checks the card in the graveyard instead, the base variant will differ.
